Work_item: Feature flag and authorized tenant context
Acceptance_criteria: New agency routes are server-gated; invited consultant resolves correct company; ambiguous/foreign context is rejected.
Additive migrations; membership and client belong to same company; creator grant and archive behavior tested.
CRUD/search/pagination/contact/grant APIs enforce admin/recruiter/viewer rules and reject foreign nested IDs.
Nullable client FK; valid accessible same-company links; foreign/archived assignments rejected; old jobs unchanged.

Work_item: Clients UI and job client selector
Acceptance_criteria: Real create/list/detail/contact/job-link flow; role-aware actions; feature-off UI remains unchanged.
Two-company/two-client tests pass; invited-member shell case covered; staging demo and flag-off regression pass.
Reviewed finance/operations demo profiles; job pins published version; future edits do not change active attempts.
CAD compensation displays correctly; min/max/period validated; wallet currencies and legacy salary bands unaffected.
CV/LinkedIn requirements follow pinned schema in UI/API; legacy defaults remain; email-dependent downstream flows remain valid.
Declaration/upload/verified states distinct; each unresolved check has owner and reason; hard requirements cannot be averaged away.
Tasks map to actual jobs; anchor ratings agreed; reviewers calibrate sample evidence; approval/version recorded.
Approved file types/limits; evidence is private; unauthorized downloads denied; existing text/MCQ paths work.
Confirmed human ratings separate from AI suggestions; rubric version and evidence retained.
One engine per job; guarded transitions with actor/reason/version; concurrent/idempotent requests cannot progress twice.
Use existing scheduler/review foundation; approved questions and competency ratings retained consistently.
Outbox/retries/manual failure queue work; repeated events do not duplicate invites or charges; delivery state visible.
Readiness: Requires working production delivery before pilot

Acceptance_criteria: Published allowlisted snapshot plus sharing authorization; private notes and unrelated documents excluded.
Revocable expiring reviewer sessions; no agency-team privilege; only authorized approved packets/files accessible.
Interview/info/hold/decline decisions record actor/time/reason and notify responsible consultant.
Accepted offer differs from actual start; authorized consultant can record and schedule agreed follow-up.
Time-to-shortlist, client response, drop-off and placement measures use captured events; blocked/overdue work visible.
Full real-stack journey and software-hiring regression pass; service health, data scope, support owner and rollback documented.
Issuer/source/status/expiry and authorized evidence recorded; provider failure becomes pending/manual review.
Location/assessor/resources booked; critical checklist items and retests recorded by permitted assessor.
Working phone verification/follow-up and abuse controls; no forced CV/LinkedIn; shared phones do not trigger unsafe identity merges.
Selected/accepted/ready/started remain distinct; requirements evaluated for relevant start/assignment dates.
Role/site/jurisdiction matrix approved; evidence verifies appropriate competence; no automatic industry certification claim.
